title: Core Septet #48
prompt:
Image format: a landscape-orientation photograph, 16:9 aspect ratio, significantly wider than it is tall, seven women in a single row.

A photograph of SEVEN women standing side by side in a single row at the same ground level on a plain seamless deep-charcoal backdrop, nothing else in the frame, each woman in her own distinct pose, generous horizontal spacing between each so every figure reads clearly and large within the frame, all real photographic skin with visible pores, no illustration finish, no CG sheen, all faces, hands and feet in correct proportion. The camera set back so all 7 fit comfortably within the wide frame from head to toe, 50mm lens at f/8, a single hard key light raking across all of them from one side, sharp focus head to toe on each — a real photograph, not an illustration, not CGI, not a render.

Left to right:
[Uzbek Silk Road Glam / Glamour Hourglass]: Uzbek woman, mid 40s, sultry, a jewelled brow ornament, deep red lips, warm olive skin, a regal composed expression, sleek silver-grey hair styled in high ponytail, coffin nails (glittery). An extraordinarily large woman, far beyond any real person. a stunning hourglass figure, far more dramatically curved than any ordinary woman. A full, rounded bust, a dramatically narrow, sharply cinched waist with a deep shadowed groove running around her middle, and wide, curvaceous hips flaring well beyond her shoulders, soft rounded thighs, toned but soft arms. Not thin, not androgynous, not boyish, not a straight figure. Her arms, hands, legs and feet stay in correct proportion to each other. Correct proportion in hands/feet. Painted in Hungarian Kalocsa folk painted motif (a deep black ground with bright red, pink and gold folk-art florals), covering her whole body below the jaw with no bare skin, face unpainted. Pose: mid-stride walking toward camera. Shoes: extreme gold extreme platform high heels.

[Nordic valkyrie / Heavy Muscle]: Norwegian woman, early 40s, cheerful, fair skin with a light scatter of freckles, strong straight defined dark-blonde brows, warm bronze shadow across the lids, a fine brown liner, long lashes, large pale-blue eyes with bright real catchlights, soft contour, a muted red-brown lip, a fierce, steady, commanding expression, natural soft black hair styled in flat glossy finger waves styled close to the scalp, stiletto nails (glossy). An extraordinarily large woman, far beyond any real person. an enormous, overwhelmingly muscular woman. Massive thick arms with heavy defined muscle, a broad powerful muscular back, a huge powerful chest, a heavy dense muscular torso and legs, only a soft hint of a waistline. Enormous round hips and colossal thick thighs with muscle visible through a soft layer, thick heavy calves. Not slim, not lean. Her arms, hands, legs and feet stay in correct proportion to each other. Correct proportion in hands/feet. Painted in Egyptian Mamluk brass-and-enamel inlay (a deep black ground with fine gold and silver geometric star inlay), covering her whole body below the jaw with no bare skin, face unpainted. Pose: leaning against a wall just out of frame. Shoes: extreme gold-and-silver extreme platform wedges.

[Persian Glam / Black Glamour]: Iranian woman, early 20s, bold and confident, richly kohl-lined almond eyes, a deep berry-red lip, thick dark brows, warm olive skin, soft rose-gold hair styled in many small bantu knots covering the scalp, almond nails (glossy). An extraordinarily large woman, far beyond any real person. A dramatically impossible waist-to-hip ratio dominates her silhouette: a colossal heavy bust, an extremely sharply cinched waist pulled in far tighter than the waistline of any of her other curves, and then enormous round hips flaring out to a width many times greater than that narrow waist. Gigantic soft thighs pressed together, very thick soft arms, a gigantic rounded rear. Her head looks small on top of her massive body. Not a plus-size model, not evenly proportioned. Her arms, hands, legs and feet stay in correct proportion to each other. Correct proportion in hands/feet. Painted in Spanish Andalusian filigree (a deep black ground with fine silver filigree in geometric star patterns), covering her whole body below the jaw with no bare skin, face unpainted. Pose: seated across two steps. Shoes: extreme silver extreme platform lace-up sandals.

[Uzbek Silk Road Glam / Powerlifter]: Uzbek woman, mid 40s, sultry, a jewelled brow ornament, deep red lips, warm olive skin, a regal composed expression, icy platinum-blonde hair styled in curly, stiletto nails (matte). An extraordinarily large woman, far beyond any real person. an enormous, overwhelmingly powerful woman. Colossal thick trapezius muscle rising high around her neck, massive round boulder shoulders, enormous thick arms with dense hard muscle, a broad powerful back, a deeply carved abdomen, colossal glutes and hips extending far beyond the shoulders, gigantic quadriceps with a deep sweep. Her head looks small on top of her massive frame. Not slim, not a fitness body, powerful and heavy at once. Her arms, hands, legs and feet stay in correct proportion to each other. Correct proportion in hands/feet. Painted in Hungarian Kalocsa folk painted motif (a deep black ground with bright red, pink and gold folk-art florals), covering her whole body below the jaw with no bare skin, face unpainted. Pose: both hands framing her own face. Shoes: extreme gold platform stiletto ankle boots.

[hime-gyaru / Heavy Muscle]: Japanese woman, mid 30s, cheerful, fair porcelain skin, soft pink blush across the cheeks, sparkling pink eyeshadow, long curled lashes, large eyes with bright real catchlights, glossy candy-pink lips, a sweet princess-like smile, bold vivid violet-purple hair styled in a short pixie cut, oval nails (chrome). An extraordinarily large woman, far beyond any real person. an enormous, overwhelmingly muscular woman. Massive thick arms with heavy defined muscle, a broad powerful muscular back, a huge powerful chest, a heavy dense muscular torso and legs, only a soft hint of a waistline. Enormous round hips and colossal thick thighs with muscle visible through a soft layer, thick heavy calves. Not slim, not lean. Her arms, hands, legs and feet stay in correct proportion to each other. Correct proportion in hands/feet. Painted in Croatian Hvar filigree-inspired linework (an ivory ground with fine cream and gold painted filigree linework), covering her whole body below the jaw with no bare skin, face unpainted. Pose: leaning against a wall just out of frame. Shoes: extreme gold extreme platform thigh-skimming boots.

[Persian Glam / Curved Bust]: Iranian woman, early 50s, bold and confident, richly kohl-lined almond eyes, a deep berry-red lip, thick dark brows, warm olive skin, bold vivid electric-blue hair styled in a sleek wet-look slicked straight back, coffin nails (holographic). An extraordinarily large woman, far beyond any real person. Both her bust and her hips are simultaneously, dramatically enormous — a colossal heavy bust resting full and wide, and enormous round hips flaring just as dramatically wide below — but unlike a sharply cinched hourglass, her waistline stays soft and only gently defined between them, a full, natural figure rather than a snatched one. Gigantic soft thighs pressed together, very thick soft arms, a full round face. Her head looks small on top of her massive body. Her arms, hands, legs and feet stay in correct proportion to each other. Correct proportion in hands/feet. Painted in Peruvian Nazca painted pattern (a deep terracotta ground densely painted with stylised gold figures), covering her whole body below the jaw with no bare skin, face unpainted. Pose: kneeling on both knees, facing camera. Shoes: extreme gold extreme platform lace-up sandals.

[Hong Kong-style / USSBBW]: Chinese woman, late 20s, cheerful, fair matte skin with a soft powdery finish, thin sharply arched brows, soft brown and rose eyeshadow, a fine black liner with a small flick, long curled lashes, large eyes with bright real catchlights, a strong rose-red blush on the apples of the cheeks, deep glossy red lips with a defined edge, a poised, glamorous expression, bold vivid magenta-pink hair styled in many small bantu knots covering the scalp, oval nails (matte). An extraordinarily large woman, far beyond any real person. An immense mass of soft heavy fat sits on her middle, sagging down toward her knees under its own weight, gathering into three or four heavy rounded folds stacked one above the other, deep shadowed creases between them, never taut, never smooth, never round like a drum, not pregnant. A gigantic bust resting on the top fold, no waist at all, colossal hips more than three times the width of her shoulders, each thigh thicker than a normal woman's waist, thick heavy calves. Her head looks small on top of her massive body. Her arms, hands, legs and feet stay in correct proportion to each other. Correct proportion in hands/feet. Painted in Turkish İznik tile (a brilliant white ground with cobalt-blue tulips and curling stems), covering her whole body below the jaw with no bare skin, face unpainted. Pose: kneeling on one knee, the other raised. Shoes: extreme cobalt-and-coral extreme platform wedges.

Composition: each woman's own pose as described, inner arms not crossing her neighbours, every woman an extraordinarily large woman far beyond any real person, generous horizontal spacing so every figure reads clearly and large.

Lighting: the hard raking light carving every fold and curve on all 7, catching each woman's own painted pattern distinctly. Shot on a Hasselblad X2D, 16:9 landscape 8K.
